question: Using the sales data, what is the median value of total sales made in countries where the number of customers is greater than 4?
sql:
WITH country_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Country,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerId) AS num_customers,
        SUM(i.Total) AS total_sales
    FROM customers c
    JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.Country
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT total_sales
    FROM country_sales
    WHERE num_customers > 4
)
SELECT MEDIAN(total_sales) AS median_total_sales
FROM filtered
